name: Higgsfield
shortDescription: AI video app with Cinema Studio camera-motion presets for cinematic clips.
longDescription: Higgsfield is an AI video app. Its Cinema Studio help page describes cinematic video with camera-motion control, and the Cinema Studio 4.0 blog lists 30+ camera-movement presets, including POV, robot arm, pan, and helicopter shot, plus clips up to 30 seconds. The pricing page did not include a readable monthly plan.
pricingNotes: A monthly plan price was not in the readable pricing-page text. Confirm it on the official pricing page.
bestFor: Short clips for a game, a stream, or a sizzle reel
strength: Cinema Studio 4.0, described on the official blog, offers 30+ camera-movement presets and clips up to 30 seconds.
weakness: The pricing page did not include a readable monthly plan, so no subscription price is listed.
smokeTestNotes: Official homepage, Cinema Studio help page, blog, and pricing URL were reviewed.

useCaseFit.video-generation: Generates cinematic clips with camera presets such as a POV or a helicopter shot.
